method: Extract cache/freshness strings via scripts/quality/audit-freshness.py into freshness.json, then judge per app: (a) cached content stays usable offline, (b) freshness is stated honestly (timestamp/'since'/stale marker) where content can go stale, (c) cache preservation on failure is explicit. Local-only apps with no cache concept pass by design (save integrity already covered under APPQA-02).

arxiv.notes: Kept papers readable offline with progress; rows that need the network are marked 'offline - ...' so a kept paper is never mistaken for a fresh listing ('the row no longer shows is a kept paper the reader cannot find again without a network'). Evidence: freshness.json + APPQA-02 notes.

brief.notes: Gold-standard freshness line: as_of() states 'When this brief was fetched and where from, in one line'; offline shows the saved brief and says so; save-failure vs not-saved states distinct. Evidence: freshness.json + main.rs as_of.

fanshelf.notes: Per-work DownloadState drives availability; update checks stamp freshness ('No new chapters as of {date}'); downloaded copies readable offline, removal keeps reading places. Evidence: freshness.json + main.rs:242.

homepanel.notes: 'Offline since HH:MM. Readings may be stale.' is the freshest honesty in the catalog - age-stamped staleness, cached tiles stay usable. Evidence: freshness.json + main.rs:229.

kitchencard.notes: Sync reports kept-vs-unreadable counts ('Kept X of Y recipes; N arrived unreadable'); offline mode keeps saved recipes cookable and says the radio is off. Evidence: freshness.json + APPQA-02 notes.

post.notes: Cached letters stay readable; every failure names the cache ('Your cached list is unchanged' / 'Your cached letters are still here'); queued replies survive failure with state named. Evidence: freshness.json + main.rs:303-340.

rss.notes: Saved articles and subscriptions survive offline; failure taxonomy (APPQA-02) always names what is kept; feed-status surface shows per-feed fetch state. Evidence: freshness.json + feed-status.png.

rss-miniflux.notes: Every failure class names preservation ('Your previous articles are kept'); batch writer includes anything fetched since the sync (no lost updates); per-tab empty states. Evidence: freshness.json + main.rs:191.

gutenbird.notes: restore_cached_feed keeps the last catalog usable; downloads readable offline; offline dictionary section honest about coverage. Evidence: freshness.json + main.rs restore_cached_feed.

calibre-web.notes: Cached catalog and downloaded books stay usable offline; every failure names the kept state ('Your current catalog is kept', 'The saved library is kept'); previous account preserved until a checked replacement is acknowledged. Content is user-managed inventory, so no persistent age marker is needed - the sync moment names what changed. Evidence: freshness.json + reading.rs + settings.rs.

hn.notes: Saved articles are on-device and open instantly ('Never drawn: the saved list is already on the device'); live tabs require the network and fail with the APPQA-02 taxonomy rather than showing stale content as fresh. Evidence: freshness.json + main.rs saved handling.

lichess.notes: Downloaded puzzle sessions are the offline-training cache, labeled as such ('Offline training'); stale stored positions are refused, not restored (stale_pre_fix_puzzle_position_is_not_restored test); stream cancellation cannot clear new state. Evidence: freshness.json + main.rs:5882-7052.

pubquiz.notes: Synced packs are the offline cache and stay playable ('Off the air. Existing packs still play offline.'); sync failures keep prior packs. Evidence: freshness.json + main.rs:1018.

readlater.notes: Unread/starred/archive lists are the offline reading cache; sync failures keep current articles and say so; storage-limit state names the remedy. Evidence: freshness.json + APPQA-02 notes.

panels.notes: Downloads are the offline cache; server-side changes are DETECTED and named ('The comic on your server has changed. Remove this download and start again.') - freshness verification, not silent staleness. Evidence: freshness.json + transfer.rs:143.

musicstand.notes: Synced scores/setlists are on-device content; page failures name re-push remedy. Content is user-owned files - no staleness concept needed. Evidence: freshness.json + APPQA-02 notes.

needles.notes: Synced patterns are on-device content with per-collection state; sync cancellation named. User-owned files, no staleness concept. Evidence: freshness.json + main.rs:204-362.

syncthing.notes: Sync state is age-honest by design: 'Sync has not run' vs first-sync vs retry-next-window vs radio-budget per day; files import after every window once paired. Evidence: freshness.json + main.rs:45-229.

verses.notes: Offline shelf is the primary design; daily poem rotates by date honestly (date-driven, chrome-only asserts in routes); search requires network and fails with the APPQA-02 taxonomy. Evidence: freshness.json + APPQA-02 notes.

vault.notes: Local notes pushed/ingested via CLI; partial-import failures are counted and named ('{failures} note(s) did not import; see About Vault'); unreadable entries kept intact. Evidence: freshness.json + APPQA-02 notes.

deck.notes: No content cache; the 'last action' line honestly reports what the computer answered, which is the only freshness that exists for a remote-control surface. Evidence: freshness.json + main.rs:12-174.

audiobook.notes: Created books and the sample are on-device content ('Saved on this reader'); creation needs the network and failures name what was kept. No cache-freshness concept beyond that. Evidence: freshness.json.

birds.notes: Local content only - no network cache concept, nothing to go stale. Save-state integrity and failure honesty covered under APPQA-02. Snapshot-read failure surfaces with detail (APPQA-02).

chat.notes: Conversations are local records of a live service; the save format is versioned and refuses unknown versions rather than restoring garbage. Nothing cached to go stale. Evidence: freshness.json.

crossword.notes: Local content only - no network cache concept, nothing to go stale. Save-state integrity and failure honesty covered under APPQA-02. Progress per puzzle with decode-refusal on damaged records (APPQA-02).

fieldbook.notes: Outings/sightings are owner-generated records; failed writes are named ('Not saved. The last write failed.'); packs pushed via CLI. Evidence: freshness.json.

flashcards.notes: Review log is the local state; failed saves name the repair path ('Export or repair the local review log'); imported schedules left unchanged on failure. Evidence: freshness.json.

frame.notes: Pushed albums are on-device content; transfer-record mismatches are detected and named with re-push remedy - freshness verification for pushed content. Evidence: freshness.json + APPQA-02 notes.

gallery.notes: Component catalog; cache/freshness specimens are themselves the reviewed states (APPQA-05). Counted for census completeness.

grimoire.notes: Local content only - no network cache concept, nothing to go stale. Save-state integrity and failure honesty covered under APPQA-02. Bundled reference document.

habits.notes: Local content only - no network cache concept, nothing to go stale. Save-state integrity and failure honesty covered under APPQA-02. Degraded-mode honesty on load failure (APPQA-02).

inkling.notes: Local content only - no network cache concept, nothing to go stale. Save-state integrity and failure honesty covered under APPQA-02. Damaged saves ignored and named ('Saved game was damaged and was ignored.').

logicpack.notes: Local content only - no network cache concept, nothing to go stale. Save-state integrity and failure honesty covered under APPQA-02. Non-destructive save-corruption handling (APPQA-02).

magnet.notes: Local content only - no network cache concept, nothing to go stale. Save-state integrity and failure honesty covered under APPQA-02. Live sensor readings only.

morse.notes: Local content only - no network cache concept, nothing to go stale. Save-state integrity and failure honesty covered under APPQA-02. Bundled code table.

nonograms.notes: Local content only - no network cache concept, nothing to go stale. Save-state integrity and failure honesty covered under APPQA-02. Import manifest validation taxonomy (APPQA-02).

paperterm.notes: Live terminal sessions; the preview is explicitly labeled sample output. No cache to go stale. Evidence: freshness.json.

parlor.notes: Local content only - no network cache concept, nothing to go stale. Save-state integrity and failure honesty covered under APPQA-02. Game saves with resume.

parser.notes: Local content only - no network cache concept, nothing to go stale. Save-state integrity and failure honesty covered under APPQA-02. In-world SAVE/RESTORE; story validation shared with CLI.

sidekick.notes: Live question board; stale-question honesty ('gone before the answer arrived'). No content cache. Evidence: freshness.json.

sudoku.notes: Local content only - no network cache concept, nothing to go stale. Save-state integrity and failure honesty covered under APPQA-02. Save kept + retry-reading on failure (APPQA-02).

tictactoe.notes: Local content only - no network cache concept, nothing to go stale. Save-state integrity and failure honesty covered under APPQA-02.

todo.notes: Local content only - no network cache concept, nothing to go stale. Save-state integrity and failure honesty covered under APPQA-02. Save-on-every-change with load-failure splash (APPQA-02).

backgammon.notes: Local content only - no network cache concept, nothing to go stale. Save-state integrity and failure honesty covered under APPQA-02. Versioned autosave with migration (APPQA-02).
